International Monohull Open Class Association (IMOCA) Globe Series Skipper Pip Hare, leader of team Pip Hare Ocean Racing, talks about her IMOCA experiences, the extreme challenges of solo ocean yacht racing, and the integral role satellite communication plays in safety, performance…
